what: SHA-256 of the six reference files written by loomora_refgen (basic, empty, escape40, multi, multi-light, one). Reference = the six hashes of the golden constants of core/tests/format_selftest.cpp, held once in the files stored under validation/evidence/adr-0021/windows-11-x64/. Files byte-identical to the reference are not stored again (ADR 0014); only their hash is recorded here.
platform_note: Run on the Android 7.0 (API 24) x86_64 emulator (Android emulator 37.2.13.0, AVD API24 = system image android-24 default x86_64, 1,536 MB, WHPX, headless). The third run below is on ANOTHER system, Android 15 (API 35, AVD API35 = system image android-35 default x86_64, plain AOSP, 2,048 MB), for which no platform record exists (tools/run_vectors.py derives the id android-15-x86_64): it is kept in this file as a separate run, not as a platform, and is NOT a run on Android 7.0. The first run is a 32-bit x86 process on the x86_64 image (the id a probe line gives it is android-7.0-x86, which has no record either). The sizes are those of the reference files: the run recorded the six SHA-256 (core/tests/android_results.json / web_results.json of the main repository), not the sizes, and an equal SHA-256 means equal bytes.
